content: Official product pages cross-checked across Astro Gold, CHANI, TimePassages, and Astro.com show a stable core: create/save natal charts; single and bi-wheel natal/transit visualization; placements and aspect listings; selectable dates or current transits; point-and-click interpretations; chart display preferences; and saved/recent chart management. Advanced products add progressions, returns, directions, profections, dynamic listings, and extensive calculation customization, which are later-stage rather than natal/transit MVP requirements.
